units.source_text: “不过，不是天天都记，也有间歇的时候。

en.t: But I do not write in it every day; sometimes there are gaps.

units.source_text: 在这山沟沟里，所谓出席宴会，还不是老一套？

en.t: Here in this mountain hollow, going to a banquet is just the same old routine, isn't it?

units.source_text: 今年只买到那种每页都带年月日的，不合适。

en.t: This year I could only buy the kind with the year, month, and day printed on every page, so it is not suitable.

units.source_text: 因为有时一下笔就写得很长。”

en.t: Because once I start writing, sometimes it gets very long."
